entries.reason: The current v38 runtime classifies face holes as PK_LOOP_type_inner_c; the legacy PK_LOOP_type_hole_c token is not emitted by the deterministic manifold seeds.
entries.recheckWhen: A fixed public-API recipe produces PK_LOOP_type_hole_c and survives transmit/receive.

entries.reason: The current v38 runtime uses outer/winding classifications for peripheral boundaries; the legacy PK_LOOP_type_peripheral_c token is not emitted by deterministic manifold seeds.
entries.recheckWhen: A fixed public-API recipe produces PK_LOOP_type_peripheral_c and survives transmit/receive.

entries.reason: The deterministic ring-loop seed creates an empty loop classified as error rather than inner_sing; no legal inner-singular manifold fixture is retained.
entries.recheckWhen: A face-with-hole or degenerate-face seed produces PK_LOOP_type_inner_sing_c and passes receive/body comparison.

entries.reason: The degenerate cone apex is represented by a vertex loop and its edge has zero endpoint vertices; the tested cylinder and sheet edges are ring/two-endpoint edges.
entries.recheckWhen: A legal manifold seed with exactly one edge endpoint is available.

entries.reason: These are diagnostic classifications produced for incomplete or ambiguous topology and cannot be requested as a legal manifold standard form.
